sources.fullCitation: Universal Filmlexikon 1932. Europa / Europe, edited by Frank Arnau. Berlin: Universal Filmlexikon G.m.b.H., Oranienstrasse 140/142; London: London General Press, 6 Bouverie Street. Entry for Karl M. May with portrait, p. 280; the portrait is credited “phot: Willinger Berlin.” Digitised copy at the Internet Archive.

media.title: Karl Michael May — Universal Filmlexikon, 1932
media.altText: Black-and-white close portrait of the composer Karl Michael May, head tilted and turned to the side.
media.publicCaption: Karl Michael May, who composed with Kaper the songs recorded here, in the portrait printed beside his entry in the Universal Filmlexikon of 1932, credited “phot: Willinger Berlin.”
media.publicCreditLine: Photograph credited “Willinger, Berlin”; Universal Filmlexikon 1932, p. 280; digitized copy at Internet Archive.
